definitions.cnr: absolute mean gray difference / ring gray std, RGB resized with INTER_AREA to long side640; ring dilation radius3 excludes every labelled instance
definitions.solidity: polygon area / convex hull area; shape proxy, not verified occlusion label
definitions.neighbor: another labelled mask pixel within square Chebyshev radius2 of this mask; proxy, not split/merge error
definitions.scope: train and val only; no test image/shape analysis; existing labels not manually certified complete
